assumption_note: Each window is evaluated once, 1 minute after it opens, using the real Kalshi Yes/No quotes at that minute and Coinbase 1-minute / 5-minute BTC candles. Trades use a $5 stake, the official quadratic taker fee, and are held to Kalshi’s official Yes/No settlement. The live bot can also enter later in a window (on a 5-minute scan) or exit early if momentum flips; those live extras are not in this backtest.
fee_note: Paper PnL includes Kalshi’s taker fee: ceil(0.07 × contracts × price × (1 − price)), rounded up to the next cent.
